title: Slow Cooker Lentil & Sweet Potato Stew
description: Lentils, sweet potatoes, tomatoes, and pantry spices simmer into a filling hands-off vegetarian stew.

ingredients.item: dry brown or green lentils, rinsed

substitutions: Use peeled white potatoes instead of sweet potatoes.
Use chicken broth if vegetarian is not needed.
Add 2 cups chopped spinach during the final 10 minutes if you have it.

steps.text: Add everything to the slow cooker.
Cook until the lentils and sweet potatoes are tender.

cookSteps.text: Add 1 1/2 cups rinsed lentils, 2 cups diced sweet potato, 1 can diced tomatoes, 5 cups vegetable broth, 1 teaspoon garlic powder, 1 teaspoon cumin, 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika, and 1/2 teaspoon salt to the slow cooker. Stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for about 6 hours, until the lentils and sweet potatoes are tender. Stir and add a splash of broth or water if you want a thinner stew.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.

title: Sheet-Pan Sausage, Cabbage & Apples
description: Sliced sausage, cabbage, and apples roast together for a simple sweet-savory dinner with very little cleanup.
substitutions: Use yellow mustard instead of Dijon for a milder flavor.

steps.text: Season the sausage, cabbage, and apples.

cookSteps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. On a sheet pan, toss 12 ounces sliced cooked sausage, 5 cups chopped cabbage, and 2 sliced apples with 2 tablespoons oil, 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper.
Spread into an even layer and roast for 25 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the cabbage is tender at the edges and the sausage is browned.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat in a skillet, oven, or microwave.

title: Leftover Rice & Black Bean Burrito Bowls
description: Cold leftover rice becomes a fast warm lunch or dinner with black beans, corn, salsa, and cheese.
substitutions: Use pinto beans instead of black beans.
Use canned drained corn instead of frozen.
Add avocado, sour cream, or lime at the table if available.

steps.text: Warm the rice, beans, corn, and salsa.

cookSteps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add 3 cups leftover rice, 1 drained can black beans, 1 cup frozen corn, and 3/4 cup salsa. Cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until hot throughout.
Divide among 4 bowls and sprinkle with 1/2 cup shredded cheddar.

storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days. Reheat until steaming hot.

title: Small-Batch Banana Bread Pudding
description: A small pan turns stale bread and one ripe banana into a soft cinnamon custard dessert for four.
substitutions: Use brioche, sandwich bread, or rolls.
Use white sugar instead of brown sugar.
Add 2 tablespoons raisins or chocolate chips if desired.

cookSteps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F and butter a small baking dish with 1 tablespoon butter. Whisk 1 mashed banana, 1 egg, 1 cup milk, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon, and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla if using.
Fold in 3 cups stale bread cubes and let them stand for 5 minutes so they absorb the custard.
Transfer to the baking dish and bake for 30 minutes, until the center is set and the top is lightly golden.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat individual portions gently in the microwave.
